data_quality-g01.shared_root_cause: Currency conversion looked up the exchange rate for the report run date instead of each order's transaction date, so historical periods were re-priced at current rates.

data_quality-g02.shared_root_cause: Daily and hourly aggregates were bucketed on UTC boundaries instead of each store's configured local time zone.

data_quality-g03.shared_root_cause: Identity resolution matched on email alone, so in-store shoppers recorded with a shared placeholder email were merged into one profile.

data_quality-g04.shared_root_cause: Average order value rollups averaged lower-level averages instead of recomputing total revenue over total orders.

data_quality-g05.shared_root_cause: Sources delivering amounts in minor units (cents) were configured with the major-unit amount format, inflating values 100 times.

data_quality-g06.shared_root_cause: Stock-on-hand snapshots were summed across the days of the period instead of taking the period-end value.

data_quality-g07.shared_root_cause: Orders were joined one-to-many to their promotion codes, so orders with stacked codes contributed their revenue more than once.

data_quality-g08.shared_root_cause: Partial refunds were deducted twice: once through the source's adjusted order total and again through the separate refund record.

data_quality-g09.shared_root_cause: Store rows were grouped or counted on raw text labels whose case and whitespace differed between sources, instead of on the store ID.

data_quality-g10.shared_root_cause: The file importer inferred identifier columns as numeric and stripped their leading zeros, breaking lookups.

data_quality-g11.shared_root_cause: The storefront order total, which includes tax and shipping, was mapped to the net revenue metric instead of the merchandise subtotal.

data_quality-g12.shared_root_cause: Under first-match rule evaluation, newly added specific mapping rules were appended below an older catch-all rule and never fired.

data_quality-g13.shared_root_cause: The migration of calculated fields to the new formula engine dropped parentheses from saved expressions, changing operator precedence.

data_quality-g14.shared_root_cause: Currency aggregates were summed with binary floating-point arithmetic instead of fixed-point decimals, occasionally tipping the final rounding by a cent.

data_quality-g15.shared_root_cause: To-date comparisons used the whole prior period as the base instead of the same number of elapsed days.

connectivity-g01.shared_root_cause: The product added a second connector egress range (198.51.100.32/28) that the customer's firewall or gateway did not yet allow, so runs on new workers were dropped.

connectivity-g02.shared_root_cause: Corporate TLS inspection re-signs outbound traffic with an internal root CA that is missing from the client tool's trust store.

connectivity-g03.shared_root_cause: The corporate proxy refuses or strips the HTTP Upgrade needed for WebSocket connections to the real-time host live.example.net.

connectivity-g04.shared_root_cause: The customer's source server presents its leaf certificate without the intermediate certificate, so strict clients cannot build the chain.

connectivity-g05.shared_root_cause: The office's public IP changed (ISP or circuit change) while the workspace IP allow-list still held the old address.

connectivity-g06.shared_root_cause: The host page's Content-Security-Policy frame-src does not include the product's embed origin, so browsers refuse the frame.

connectivity-g07.shared_root_cause: The IdP metadata URL resolves only on the customer's internal network, so the product's metadata refresh silently fails.

connectivity-g08.shared_root_cause: Legacy clients limited to TLS 1.0/1.1 stopped connecting after the product retired those protocol versions.

connectivity-g09.shared_root_cause: The DNS validation record for the managed custom-domain certificate was deleted, so automatic renewal failed and the certificate expired.

connectivity-g10.shared_root_cause: Egress rules allowed the global ingestion hostname but not the regional hostname used after the workspace moved to the EU data region.

connectivity-g11.shared_root_cause: Path-MTU black hole: a branch tunnel with reduced MTU while ICMP fragmentation-needed messages are blocked, so large packets silently disappear.

connectivity-g12.shared_root_cause: The customer's secure web gateway blocked a newly introduced product hostname as uncategorised or newly registered.

workspace_admin-g01.shared_root_cause: The workspace time zone was never set after onboarding and stayed at the UTC default, so day boundaries and schedules used UTC.

workspace_admin-g02.shared_root_cause: Personal user preferences, set earlier or copied during a profile migration, silently override newly changed workspace defaults.

workspace_admin-g03.shared_root_cause: The fiscal year start month was left at January while the customer's fiscal year starts on 1 February.

workspace_admin-g04.shared_root_cause: The logo sanitiser strips externally linked resources (fonts and images) from uploaded SVG files, so parts of the logo disappear.

workspace_admin-g05.shared_root_cause: The custom domain was verified but 'Use custom domain in links and emails' was left off, so generated links used the default domain.

workspace_admin-g06.shared_root_cause: The dashboard configured as a home default was archived, leaving users pointed at missing content.

workspace_admin-g07.shared_root_cause: The corporate workspace template carried English (US) locale, date and week defaults that are copied into every new workspace.

workspace_admin-g08.shared_root_cause: The custom holiday calendar only covered the previous year, so the new year had no holidays and too many working days.
